applicabilityBasis.summary: USAT is designed for payment and settlement. Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. is its sole issuer and redeems USAT for eligible bank Clients at USD 1 per token, net of fees; Tether provides branding and has no issuance or redemption obligation.

genius.notes: Review dated 2026-10-07. Anchorage is an OCC-chartered uninsured national trust bank; federal-qualified-nonbank records its announced GENIUS route, not an existing PPSI approval. Its GENIUS comment letter uses forward-looking PPSI language. Public charter, issuer and rulemaking sources reviewed did not establish a token-specific GENIUS approval or official application. The Act remains pre-effective; Treasury identifies January 18, 2027 as the expected effective date and July 18, 2028 for the general DASP offer/sale prohibition. Treasury's September 30 SCRC interim rule concerns state-certification procedures and does not approve USAT. The monthly reserve hub links January through August 2026 examinations. The August 31 reserve report, signed September 28, identifies Anchorage as issuer, segregated fiduciary reserves and fixed-dollar USAT. The accountant expressly does not opine on legal compliance. USAT and Tether International's USDT have different legal issuers.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Within these public sources checked on 2026-10-07, no USAT/Anchorage GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification or regulator-confirmed GENIUS application was located. Existing bank charter and independent reserve examinations establish different facts. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the finite search. This review does not establish the absence of confidential filings or approvals elsewhere.
